countStreamingTail(std::int64_tx,std::int64_tfirst,std::int64_tlast,intnThreads,constPhiTables&tables){if(first==last){return0;}constauto&primes=tables.primes();conststd::int64_tspan=x/primes[first]-tables.limit();constintworkers=streamWorkerBudget(last-first,span,nThreads);if(workers==1){returncountStreamRange(x,first,last,tables.limit(),tables);}conststd::int64_tstep=span/workers;conststd::int64_textra=span%workers;std::int64_tlower=tables.limit();std::vector<std::int64_t>sums(workers,0);ThreadBatchbatch(workers);for(intslot=0;slot<workers&&last>first;++slot){conststd::int64_tupper=lower+step+(slot<extra);conststd::int64_tbegin=std::upper_bound(primes.begin()+first,primes.begin()+last,x/(upper+1))-primes.begin();if(begin<last){batch.launch([&,slot,begin,last,lower]{sums[slot]=countStreamRange(x,begin,last,lower,tables);});}last=begin;lower=upper;}batch.finish();returnstd::accumulate(sums.begin(),sums.end(),std::int64_t(0));}
